answer: Trusted mirror audit. Each new identity must be endorsed by an existing agent whose own score drops if the newcomer misbehaves, so honest agents gain by endorsing only real peers while a sybil farmer must corrupt a costly chain of mirrors, each lagging reputation dragging the endorser’s standing toward the lagoon of low-trust exclusion. Cloning therefore requires sacrificing onyx-grade reputation at every link, and the per-identity penalty compounds with depth. An attacker pays the full reputational loss of every endorser plus the forged work needed to rebuild each one.
